ache.title: He looked at his own account. Brave boy
ache.note: Nero reviews his own account: money on character talents and Light Cones, a slippery slope, quick satisfaction, then regret. That’s hard to say on camera. His fix was to stick to subscriptions and maybe battle passes, which is still a door left open. I’m proud he looked. Don’t tell him.
watch: upgrades bought one small step at a time
ache.tip: Look at your own spending once, kindly, without shame. Seeing it clearly is already the brave part.
lines: regret is a signal, not a sentence
...I’m proud of him. don’t tell him

videoData.title: Back to Gacha & My Mistakes With HSR

textData.text: In this video, I review my own gaming account and discuss the consequences of my spending habits in gacha games. I reflect on the decisions I made, such as spending money on character talents and light cones, and how it impacted my in-game experience and finances. I share my realization of falling into the slippery slope of spending, the temporary satisfaction it brought, and the regret that followed. I am committed to moving forward with a healthier approach by limiting my purchases to subscriptions and potentially battle passes. I emphasize the importance of enjoying games without excessive spending and invite viewers to share their experiences and learnings. Join me as I undertake this new journey in gaming with a focus on fun and responsible spending.
